test_title: PYST 08: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 08 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The CEO came up with a groundbreaking strategy to ______________ new markets and capitalise on emerging trends
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrasal verb "**break into**" means to enter a new area of activity, especially a new market.
 
• This fits the context perfectly as the CEO is looking to enter new markets and take advantage of emerging trends.
 
• The other options (break off, break out, break down) do not fit contextually or grammatically in the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Break off:** This means to end something abruptly, which does not fit the context.
 
• **Break out:** This means to start suddenly, especially something negative, which is irrelevant here.
 
• **Break down:** This means to stop functioning or to analyze something in detail, neither of which fits the context.
